assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished editorial banner illustration for JOBX, a Georgian job-search website.
Create a minimal, distinctive wide landscape illustration about daily pay, work hours and payment dates. One carefully composed arrangement of a simple cobalt-blue analog clock without numbers, a small clean paper calendar with blue abstract grid squares and two cyan highlighted dates, and a modest stack of plain coin discs with no symbols. Understated tactile matte paper-cut and softly beveled geometry, editorial design rather than stock corporate clip art or glossy 3D. Precise silhouettes, subtle soft shadows, restrained depth.
Palette: warm near-white #f4f7fd, vivid cobalt #2457e6, dark navy #17233f and a little sky cyan #16b7ef. Background is a quiet pale blue field with a single broad, very faint diagonal translucent blue shape echoing the JOBX brand. No gradients with rainbow colors. Compose the objects as a calm connected group around the center, occupying the middle 65% of the image. Generous margins and empty space on every edge, safe to crop slightly to 2:1 on small screens. Roughly 2:1 landscape canvas. It must read as an editorial cover for comparing time and wages at thumbnail size.
No words, no letters, no numbers, no currency symbols, no logos, no people, no watermarks, no UI screenshot, no border, no button. Typography will be real HTML outside the image. This is the actual artwork, not a page mockup.
